name: Sailing and Wind
description: Aeronautics: Winds & Weather adds a real wind field and cloth sails.

pages.title: Sailing and Wind
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Wind has a speed and heading, and is stronger over open ocean and at altitude.
- Only **Windcatchers** drive windmill bearings or push ships; ordinary Create sails are decoration.
- A **Keel** stops sideways slip, and a **Rudder** on a Create shaft steers.
Aeronautics: Winds & Weather adds a real wind field and cloth sails. Wind has a speed and heading, is stronger over open ocean and at altitude, and pushes ships rigged to catch it.

pages.title: Anemometer
pages.text: Measures local wind speed and outputs it as shaft rotation. [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() show the exact figure.

pages.title: Wind Vane
pages.text: Settles on the wind direction and turns its lower shaft. Goggles show the compass bearing.

pages.title: Windcatcher
pages.text: **Only Windcatchers** drive windmill [#](7A3C9A)[bearings](entry://glossary/bearing)[#]() or push ships here; ordinary Create sails are decoration. They don't stick on their own: [#](7A3C9A)[glue](entry://glossary/super_glue)[#]() them to the bearing. Face the broad side into the wind.

pages.title: Rigging a sail
pages.text:
- Stack **Masts** and run a **Yard** across them.
- Use a packed Cotton or Canvas Sail on the Yard, then click the lower opposite corner.
- Empty-hand clicks trim the yard in 8 steps.
- Sneak-use the cloth to reef it.

Cotton is light and quick. Canvas is heavy and durable.

pages.title: Yard
pages.text: Run a rope from an Aeronautics Rope Coupling to a Rope Winch for continuous trim. Shears detach it.

pages.title: Keel
pages.text: Fits under the hull, fore and aft. Stops sideways slip and turns angled wind into forward travel. Extend it for more grip.

pages.title: Rudder
pages.text: Driven by a Create shaft that sets a steady angle. Stack blades for a deeper rudder. Sneak-click to centre.

pages.title: Ship Anchor
pages.text: Secures a ship in place. Lower it with the top shaft. Light and Heavy Anchors also exist.

pages.title: Wind Rider
pages.text: A hang glider. Jump while falling to open it, jump again to stow. Campfire thermals carry you up.
